# Leveldon

Leveling guide for World of Warcraft: Forever (beta, levels 1 to 30, 30 to 60 as a preview): the fastest route for your race and class,
step by step, with quests, flight points, hearthstone, trainers and vendors. Needs Questdon 1.3.6 or newer.
Download: https://www.curseforge.com/projects/1741614

The full description (German) is in [README.md](../README.md). Bug reports are welcome as issues,
route feedback too: paste the text of `/lvd export`.
